a.lede: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
a.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion

b.lede: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.
b.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
